items.title: Degree versus signature obstruction to arithmetically Cohen-Macaulay bundles without stability hypotheses
items.author: Cristian Anghel
items.difficulty_reason: The main criterion handles arbitrary-rank unstable aCM bundles by a finite flat projection to the projective plane, Horrocks splitting, slope comparison of the pushed-forward Harder-Narasimhan filtration, majorization of splitting slopes and an exact Riemann-Roch/Bogomolov comparison. It is not merely the semistable Bogomolov inequality or the old base-point-freeness lemma. Original characteristic-zero, smooth-projective and ample base-point-free hypotheses retained. All section-ring equivalences, Hesse constructions and higher-dimensional material retained as context without extra counts.

proof_spans.label: Complete original proof of Theorem A: finite projection, splitting, majorization, HN filtration and exact Riemann-Roch comparison

contexts.label: Original introduction, full hypotheses and aCM/signature notation
